mapper.insert: INSERT INTO jobs(tenant_id,kind,business_key,payload,state,execution_class,conversation_id,execution_version, attempts,manual_retries,available_at,accepted_at,created_at) VALUES(#{tenantId},#{kind},#{businessKey},CAST(#{payload} AS JSON),'QUEUED',#{executionClass},#{conversationId},0,0,0, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6),UTC_TIMESTAMP(6),UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=LAST_INSERT_ID(id)

INSERT INTO outbox_events(tenant_id,job_id,kind,payload,dispatch_key,available_at,created_at) VALUES(#{tenantId},#{jobId},'job',JSON_OBJECT(),'initial',UTC_TIMESTAMP(6),UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=id
mapper.update: UPDATE jobs SET state='CANCELLED',owner=NULL,lease_expires_at=NULL,finished_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6),error_code='superseded' WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND execution_class='INTERACTIVE' AND CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(payload,'$.generation_epoch')) AS UNSIGNED) < #{beforeEpoch} AND state IN ('QUEUED','RETRY_WAIT','RUNNING','WAITING_INPUT')

SELECT d.id,d.enabled,d.deleted,d.version AS revision,v.id AS versionId,v.number, (SELECT MAX(v2.number) FROM document_versions v2 WHERE v2.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND v2.document_id=d.id) AS latestNumber,v.job_id FROM knowledge_documents d JOIN document_versions v ON v.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND v.document_id=d.id WHERE d.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND d.id=#{documentId} AND v.id=#{versionId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE jobs SET state='RETRY_WAIT',manual_retries=manual_retries+1,budget_revision=budget_revision+1,attempts=0,owner=NULL,lease_expires_at=NULL,started_at=NULL,deadline_at=NULL,finished_at=NULL,error_code=NULL,error_message=NULL,result=NULL,accepted_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6),available_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND state='FAILED' AND budget_revision=#{revision}

UPDATE ai_runs SET state='QUEUED',budget_revision=budget_revision+1,model_requests_reserved=0,tool_executions_reserved=0,classification_attempted=0,classification_result=NULL,started_at=NULL,finished_at=NULL,input_expires_at=NULL,error_code=NULL,terminal_reason=NULL,`usage`=NULL WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND job_id=#{id} AND budget_revision=#{revision} AND state='FAILED'
UPDATE document_versions SET status='queued' WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{versionId} AND job_id=#{id} AND status!='ready'
mapper.select: SELECT j.id FROM jobs j JOIN ai_runs r ON r.tenant_id=j.tenant_id AND r.job_id=j.id WHERE j.state='WAITING_INPUT' AND r.state='WAITING_INPUT' AND r.input_expires_at<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) ORDER BY j.id LIMIT 100
mapper.update: UPDATE jobs SET state='RUNNING',owner=#{owner},execution_version=execution_version+1,attempts=attempts+1,lifetime_attempts=lifetime_attempts+1, lease_expires_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)+INTERVAL #{leaseSeconds} SECOND,started_at=COALESCE(started_at,UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)), deadline_at=COALESCE(deadline_at,UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)+INTERVAL #{deadlineSeconds} SECOND),finished_at=NULL WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND state IN('QUEUED','RETRY_WAIT') AND available_at<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)

UPDATE jobs SET state=#{state},error_code=#{code},finished_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6),owner=NULL,lease_expires_at=NULL WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id}
UPDATE jobs SET state='RETRY_WAIT',error_code=#{code},available_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)+INTERVAL #{delay} SECOND,owner=NULL,lease_expires_at=NULL WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO outbox_events(tenant_id,job_id,kind,payload,dispatch_key,available_at) SELECT tenant_id,id,'job',JSON_OBJECT(),#{key},available_at FROM jobs j WHERE j.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND j.id=#{jobId} ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE outbox_events.id=outbox_events.id
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_runs SET state=#{state},error_code=#{code},terminal_reason=#{code},started_at=IF(#{state}='RUNNING',COALESCE(started_at,UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)),started_at),finished_at=IF(#{state} IN('RUNNING','QUEUED'),NULL,UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND job_id=#{jobId}
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM jobs WHERE (state='RUNNING' AND (lease_expires_at<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) OR deadline_at<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6))) OR (state IN('QUEUED','RETRY_WAIT') AND ((deadline_at IS NOT NULL AND deadline_at<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) OR (started_at IS NULL AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,accepted_at,UTC_TIMESTAMP(6))>=IF(execution_class='INTERACTIVE',#{foregroundQueue},#{backgroundQueue})))) ORDER BY id LIMIT 100
